svg.title: prepare_data — every gate, check and branch in one call
svg.desc: An invalid request, unreadable files, no usable raw rows, an unusable simulation replicate, an incompatible pre-extracted table or no usable observations fails the call. File sources are extracted by computed rules and LLM workers whose invalid output is retried; a chunk that exhausts its retries is left out with a warning. Pre-extracted Parquet selects declared variables and optional anchor dates without extraction. The new panel is then profiled, and every data-quality issue is saved as a warning.
